interpretation: The row symmetries now touch the physical holonet interfaces.  A row action selects a BT1411 detector slot, hands that slot to the BT1374 mirror residue, and occupies the matching BT1407 Hesse epilogue lane for its C3 channel and row-value slot.
physical_firewall: The D4 square subgroup is compiled as native square-pulse routing. The remaining S4 actions are analyzer/ABI relabel actions: they are finite pulse schedules, not a calibrated optical switch-loss model.
title: ABI row-action physical pulse compiler
